build: Modwerk's linker: the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…3e58) + Filter Hz 1.2.1 from this folder, --version FZ78
conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; FLTR opens the FILTER page of track BD; encoder 4 (FRQ) is turned down from 127 to 60 and back to 127. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. 1.2.1 (2026-11-14): this plan in rytm-emu c5732f0 gives the three 1.2.0 frames byte for byte on FZ78, as on FZ74 (1.2.0 rebuilt from main, main OS 2d8aead1…948d): 1.2.1 changes nothing unlocked. frq-locked.png is new: rytm-emu 2ac0f1f (c5732f0 did not take the held-trig lock), cold boot, FRQ set to 127 by CC 74, GRID RECORDING, trig 1 held and knob E nudged once, which locks the value; frame taken with the trig held. On FZ74 the same plan shows 21.1kHz sticking out of stock's 27-pixel box. The 1.2.0 frames were first captured (2026-10-14) with rytm-emu 3c4c42c on FZ01, an OS 1.73 build.
